title: Zombie Base Defense — ART_RULES (machine-readable)

palette.lootTiersNote: Align strip loot/UI highlights with RARITY_COLORS in packages/sim/src/constants.ts when showing rarity.

pixelSize.stripScaleNote: Source sprites at 1× in the strip; scale in-engine as needed.

silhouette: Readable at 1× in the strip: big head/shoulders or props; avoid fine hair strands or 1px detail that disappears at strip scale.

facing.zombies: Face left toward the base (flipX true).
facing.base: Neutral or slight three-quarter toward center.

outline: 1px dark outline on characters and large UI icons unless the style is explicitly outline-free everywhere (default: outlined for strip clarity).
